ops.en: Jacob SETTLES the sojourn-land. va-yeshev yaaqov be-eretz megure aviv — the dwell-verb Esau performed at Seir (36:8) Jacob now performs in Canaan, and megure ('sojournings') is the covenant word (17:8, 28:4) landing one verse after Esau's ledger closed on it (36:7). SPECS empty; REGISTRY 0; TESTS 0.

THE HEADER TAKES ONE SON. ele toldot yaaqov — and the ledger that formula opens elsewhere lists births; here it narrates JOSEPH alone, seventeen, shepherding: the generations of Jacob told as one boy's story.
THE EVIL REPORT. va-yave yosef et dibatam raa el avihem — the rift's first fact is Joseph's own carrying of words.

THE REPORT OPENS A LEDGER THE NEXT TWO BLOCKS CLOSE [claim G60-17]. Joseph's three reports are repaid one for one on the scales of Proverbs 16:11: the limb-of-a-living-animal charge repaid by the slaughtered goat of 37:31; calling the handmaids' sons slaves repaid by his own sale as a slave; the charge about the girls repaid by his master's wife at 39:7 (gen_62's span). Recorded at witness tier as…
THE LOVE ABOVE ALL. ve-yisrael ahav et yosef mi-kal banav ki ven zequnim hu lo.
THE COAT MADE. ve-asa lo ketonet pasim — the span's central object enters by a making-event; its verb-chain runs: made (here), stripped (37:23), dipped (37:31), sent-and-recognized (37:32-33).

THE LOVE-REASON IS DECIDED IN TRANSLATION [claim G60-22]. The grammar gives "a son of his OLD AGE"; the received translation renders "a WISE son," voting with R. Nechemya — that Jacob transmitted to Joseph all he had received from Shem and Ever — against plain chronology and against R. Yehuda's face-likeness reading. Both senses stand: the age-sense from the ink, the wisdom-sense read at witness t…

THE ONE LEAN PEACE-WORD [G60-02]. ve-lo yakhlu dabro le-shalom — the Ramah rules every shalom-language in the Torah FULL except THIS token, lean [VERIFIED: manifest G60-02; skeleton-mate = the name Shillem, Num 26:49]; Lekach Tov reads the lean skeleton as le- shalem, TO REPAY. The hatred is written into the word peace could not fill.
THE FIRST DREAM. va-yachalom yosef chalom va-yaged le-echav — dream and telling in one clause; va-yosifu od seno oto — the hatred's second increment.

THE HEAR-DEMAND PUSHED. shimu-na ha-chalom ha-ze — Joseph's only imperative to his brothers in the span. And the address-word carries a crown: aleihem written FULL, one of the Great Masorah's SEVENTEEN full tokens in the Torah — three of the seventeen stand in this chapter (37:6, 13, 18) [VERIFIED: manifest G60-03, census exact; Hilleli full vs Yerushalmi-codex lean — SNAPSHOT with the Masorah].

THE BOW-WORD'S EXACT PAIR [G60-11]. va-tishtachavena la-alumati — the sheaves' bow-form stands EXACTLY TWICE in the Torah: here in the dream, and at 33:6 — 'the handmaids drew near AND BOWED' [VERIFIED: manifest G60-11]: the Kitzur reads the pair — the first dream showed eleven brothers only, but the whole house came to bow. tesubena's tav soft per MS (asserted).

FIVE WORDS OF ONE ROOT [claim G60-15, machine-checked]. The sheaf-noun stands in the whole Torah ONLY in this verse — three times bare and a fourth carrying the prefixed lamed ("to my sheaf") — and the binding-verb ("binding sheaves") makes a fifth word of the same three letters. The reading counts those five and takes the dream's prostration as fivefold. Argues middah E10 (a repeated expression s…

THE DEMAND ANSWERED IN MOCKERY. ha-malokh timlokh alenu im mashol timshol banu — they heard (the hear-demand pops satisfied: their answer is the proof), and the reign-verb's first Israelite tokens (its toks 11-12, after Edom's ten) are a question in scorn. Hatred's third increment: al chalomotav ve-al devarav.
THE SECOND DREAM. ha-shemesh ve-ha-yareach ve-achad asar kokhavim mishtachavim li — sun, moon, eleven stars; the second witness the letter later counts as settled (42:9 remembers THE DREAMS, plural).

THE DREAM AS AN ENFORCEABLE INSTRUMENT [claim G60-18]. The reading takes the second dream not as prediction but as title, and enforces it generations later: Joshua addresses the sun at Gibeon as a wayward slave — "were you not PURCHASED with my father's money? did my father not see you bowing in the dream?" — before commanding it to stand still. Witness-tier state, never mixed into the text-ground…

THE REBUKE. va-yigar bo aviv — the Kitzur's Masorah pair rides this rebuke-verb: its partner is the rebuke of the Sea (Ps 106:9, outside the instrument) — read as the sea splitting in the merit of this rebuker, Israel the elder. Named; the Torah-side token stands here.
ENVY AND KEEPING. va-yeqanu vo echav — ve-aviv SHAMAR et ha-davar: the father stores the dream the way the span's end will store his grief.

THE DREAM IS LOGGED [claim G60-21]. "His father KEPT the matter" is read by R. Levi as an act of writing — he took a quill and set down the day, the hour and the place; R. Chiyya hears the Divine Spirit saying KEEP, for these things are destined to occur. The verse creates a dated record, which is what makes the later fulfilment auditable rather than merely remembered — the instrument-logic the wi…

THE DOTTED ET [G60-01]. lirot ET tzon avihem — the object-word is DOTTED: both letters carry the scribal dots in SNAPSHOT's stream [VERIFIED: manifest G60-01 — the FIFTH of the ten dotted places reached, layer instrumented]. The midrash MS cites: they went to pasture THEMSELVES, not the flock — the dots lift the object out of the sentence.

THE SUMMONS. lekha ve-eshlachakha alehem — pushed; Joseph answers HINENI, the readiness-word of the Aqedah's father (22:1,7,11) now in the son sent to his brothers. The demand stands open until the going (37:14).
THE SEE-DEMAND. lekh-na ree et shelom achekha ve-et shelom ha-tzon — the go-imperative folds into the errand (one demand: go-and-see).

THE WORD-DEMAND — THE SPAN'S OPEN WOUND. va-hashiveni davar ('bring me back word'): pushed here and NEVER satisfied in the span — no word of Joseph returns to this father; what returns is a coat (37:32). The Kitzur reads the phrase as a spark of the holy spirit — 'his end was to return to him.' The demand stays OPEN past the span end [watch: 45:26-27, 46:30].

THE GOING. va-yishlachehu me-emeq chevron va-yavo shekhema — the summons satisfied; the Kitzur counts the valley-word's letter-sum as the 210 years the descent will cost, and its escort-teaching (walk a departing friend, part with words of Torah) rides the verse, named.

WANDERING. ish... ve-hine toe ba-sade — the Kitzur's wander-list (a man astray, his brother's straying donkey, the man who strays from understanding) files here named; the donkey-partner is Torah-side at Exod 23:4 (the return-command the brothers will fail toward a brother). The asking man: the Kitzur's letter-count names him Gabriel, filed as reading.

THE ONE WHERE-WORD [G60-04]. hagida-na li EFO hem roim — the Ramah: the Torah's ONE where-word written with yod and final he; all its fellows are efo-with-aleph (four, exact) [VERIFIED: manifest G60-04/05]. Its only skeleton-mates: the honest EPHAH pair of Deut 25:14-15. 'My brothers I seek' — the seek-verb under the wander- verse.
THE ANSWER. nasu mi-ze... nelkha dotayna — the man tells; the quoted cohortative ('let us go') is the brothers' own overheard speech, unmodeled on the queue (reported words).
THE FINDING. va-yelekh yosef achar echav va-yimtzaem be-dotan — the see-errand discharges at the finding; only the word-demand now stands open.

THE CONSPIRACY. va-yitnaklu oto la-hamito — the plot precedes the face. alehem here is the third of the chapter's three seventeen-list tokens [G60-03]; the Kitzur's before-word list (the stumbling feet, the womb-emergence) files named.
THE TITLE IN SCORN. hine baal ha-chalomot halaze ba — 'master of the dreams': the brothers name the office they fear; the letter will crown it in Egypt.

THE KILL-DEMAND. lekhu ve-nahargehu — the summons folds into the first we-demand. This demand will DIE ON THE QUEUE: Reuben redirects it (37:22), Judah replaces it (37:27), and the letter never fires it — the span ends with the kill-demand still open and forever unexecuted.

THE THROW-DEMAND. ve-nashlikhehu be-achad ha-borot — the pit-word carries a crown [G60-06]: ha-borot lean-first-vav full-second, ONCE in the Torah so [VERIFIED: manifest G60-06; the Ramah's counter- sign, the doubly-lean hewn cisterns of Deut 6:11, asserted at its address].

THE PLANNED LIE. ve-amarnu chaya raa akhalathu — pushed as the plot's cover-story. THE MACHINE'S SHARPEST FACT: the demand is never discharged by its pushers — the brothers never say the sentence anywhere in the span; the FATHER says its exact words (37:33). The lie stays open on the queue while the deceived speaks it for them.

THE FIRST COUNTER. lo nakenu nafesh — Reuben's negated we-form against the kill-demand; the rescue-verb (va-yatzilehu) is narrated before his first word: the letter files the saving before the speech.
SHED NO BLOOD. al-tishpekhu dam — the prohibition stands (LET-NOT never resolves; it remains as standing law on the queue).

THE REDIRECT. hashlikhu oto el ha-bor asher ba-midbar — Reuben re- aims the plot's throw at HIS pit; the narrator breaks in with the purpose-clause (lemaan hatzil... la-hashivo el aviv): the letter tells us what Reuben could not say aloud.
LAY NO HAND. ve-yad al-tishlechu vo — the second prohibition; the vo's bet soft per MS (asserted).

THE STRIPPING. va-yafshitu et yosef et kutonto et ketonet ha-pasim asher alav — the coat named twice over in one clause (his coat / the stripes-coat); kutanto's tav with qamatz alone per MS (asserted). The Kitzur pairs this kutonet with Saul's torn one, named.

ONE ACT, TWO DEMANDS. va-yiqachuhu va-yashlikhu oto ha-bora — the throw fires, discharging BOTH Reuben's redirect and the plot's own throw-demand: the machine's record of how Reuben captured the conspiracy's momentum. And the TAKE is LEAN [G60-07]: va-yiqachuhu written without vav — the midrash reads the singular skeleton: WHO took him? Simeon — repaid at 42:24 [VERIFIED: manifest G60-07; skeleton…

THE EMPTY PAIR [G60-10]. ve-ha-bor REQ en bo mayim — the empty-word stands EXACTLY TWICE in the Torah: the pit here, and 'it is no EMPTY word for you' (Deut 32:47) [VERIFIED: manifest G60-10]; the reading rides the redundancy — water it had none, snakes and scorpions it had.

THE DOUBLY-FULL WALKERS [G60-08]. holkhim le-horid mitzrayma — the Torah's ONE going-word full with vav AND yod [VERIFIED: manifest G60-08]; the lean form's one station is 'if Your face does not GO' (Exod 33:15): the fullest walkers carry Joseph down, the lean walkers are the Presence going up. le-ekhol lechem — the bread over the pit — with the aleph in hataf segol per MS [VERIFIED: manifest G60-…
THE PROFIT-QUESTION. ma betza ki naharog et achinu ve-khisinu et damo — Judah prices the kill-demand and finds it worthless; the Kitzur's pair (what profit in my blood, Ps 30:10) files named.
THE SALE-DEMAND. lekhu ve-nimkerenu la-yishmeelim — Judah's we- demand supersedes the kill (which stays open, unexecuted, forever); va-yishmeu echav — the brothers heed.
OUR HAND NOT ON HIM. ve-yadenu al-tehi vo ki achinu vesarenu hu — the fourth standing prohibition; the our-flesh bet soft per MS (asserted).

THE SALE — AGENT UNRESOLVED. va-yaavru anashim midyanim socharim va- yimshekhu... va-yimkeru et yosef la-yishmeelim be-esrim kasef — the sale-demand discharges, but the letter leaves the seller's identity suspended between the brothers and the passing Midianites (the camps are named — Rashi's brothers, Rashbam's Midianites — and no one is ruled for; the RESULT is agentless by the machine's own sem…

THE DEED-CHAIN IS A RECORDED DISPUTE [claim G60-19]. R. Yudan counts FOUR bills of sale (brothers to Ishmaelites to merchants to Midianites to Egypt); R. Huna counts FIVE, adding the state treasury from which Potiphar then buys. Carried as a dispute and never decided: the machine records the sale event and refuses to fix the number of conveyances.

TWO STANDING LAWS PRICED FROM THIS NUMBER [claim G60-20, machine-checked]. The twenty pieces of silver are read as five sela'im, and the firstborn-redemption measure of five sela'im is decreed measure for measure — "you sold Rachel's firstborn for twenty"; the same twenty divided among the brothers gives the half-shekel a head of Exodus 38:26. Law-shaped claims resting on this verse's own number, …

THE FIRST TEARING. va-yashav reuven el ha-bor ve-hine en yosef ba- bor — the redirect's author returns to the emptiness his redirect made possible; va-yiqra et begadav — the span's first torn garment (the father's follows at 37:34).
THE CHILD IS NOT. ha-yeled enenu va-ani ana ani va — the eldest's sentence the brothers will repeat to Joseph's own face (42:13, 42:32): the absence-formula minted here.

THE DIPPING. va-yishchatu seir izim va-yitbelu et ha-kutonet ba-dam — the goat's blood plays Joseph's: the same animal-class whose skins played Esau's hands (27:16) now plays a son's death to the man who wore them; letter-note, the deceit-instrument returning to its first user.

HAKER-NA [G60-12]. haker-na ha-ketonet binkha hiv im-lo — the recognize-imperative joined to the please-word: the Kitzur's Masorah pair with 38:25 — 'with the phrase Judah deceived his father, with that phrase he was repaid: RECOGNIZE, please — whose seal and cords?' (Sotah 10b). The bare imperative stands three times in the Torah, ALL in Jacob's house — Laban's search (31:32), the coat, the pledg…

THE RECOGNITION — FULL AGAINST THE HILLELI [G60-09]. va-yakirah — written FULL with yod per the Ramah and the precise books, against the Hilleli copy's lean and the Meiri's scroll-book; SNAPSHOT carries the full yod [VERIFIED: manifest G60-09]: the stream rules against the Hilleli again (the Masorah's own three-lean recognize- list stands elsewhere — both Torah members at 42:7-8, where the recogni…

THE LIE IN THE FATHER'S MOUTH. chaya raa akhalathu — the EXACT words the plot queued at 37:20 ('and we will say: an evil beast devoured him') fire here as JACOB'S OWN conclusion: the brothers never say the sentence; the deceived speaks it for the deceivers, and the say- demand stays open on the queue forever — the machine's record of the letter's cruelest economy. tarof toraf yosef — the doubled t…

THE BROTHERS STAGE THE BAILEE'S DEFENCE [claim G60-16, machine-checked — NEW AT DERIVATION, not visible in the reading pass]. The father's verdict is the doubled tearing-formula ("torn, surely torn"), and that doubled pair of the tearing-root stands in exactly three places in the Torah: here, at 44:28 where Judah quotes the verdict back (gen_67's span), and at Exodus 22:12 — "if it is surely torn,…
THE SECOND TEARING. va-yiqra yaaqov simlotav — the father repeats Reuben's act (37:29) at full grief-scale: sackcloth, many days.

THE REFUSAL. va-yemaen le-hitnachem... ered el beni avel sheola — the comforters (his SONS — the sellers) rise, and the father refuses; va-yevk oto AVIV: the closing clause hands the weeping to 'his father' — Isaac still alive in Hebron weeping for the weeper, per the plain-sense chain, filed as reading.

THE SECOND SALE. ve-ha-MEDANIM makhru oto — the sellers' name shifts one letter from the Midyanim of 37:28 (Medanim/Midyanim — both Keturah-sons, 25:2; the letter's own variance, filed): the sale- chain's last link hands Joseph to Potiphar sar ha-tabachim, the address where gen_62's span will open.
